arguments:
set -u
sha256sum -c build/small-divisor-native/timing-captures/pre-capture.sha256 > build/small-divisor-native/timing-captures/source-check-before.log || exit 74
for task_native_run in first repeat; do
 cat /proc/pressure/io > build/small-divisor-native/timing-captures/"$task_native_run"-io-before.txt
 awk '/^full / {split($2,a,"="); split($3,b,"="); exit !(a[2] < 1 && b[2] < 1)}' build/small-divisor-native/timing-captures/"$task_native_run"-io-before.txt || exit 75
 date -u +%FT%TZ > build/small-divisor-native/timing-captures/"$task_native_run"-start.utc
 nice -n 10 /home/rich/bin/vfp9-probe tests/fixtures/vfp9-numeric-division-context/small-divisor-timing.prg --result build/small-divisor-native/timing-results.txt > build/small-divisor-native/timing-captures/"$task_native_run".out 2> build/small-divisor-native/timing-captures/"$task_native_run".stderr
 task_probe_rc=$?
 printf '%s\n' "$task_probe_rc" > build/small-divisor-native/timing-captures/"$task_native_run".status
 if [ "$task_probe_rc" -ne 0 ]; then exit "$task_probe_rc"; fi
 cp build/small-divisor-native/timing-results.txt build/small-divisor-native/timing-captures/"$task_native_run"-results.txt
 cat /proc/pressure/io > build/small-divisor-native/timing-captures/"$task_native_run"-io-after.txt
 date -u +%FT%TZ > build/small-divisor-native/timing-captures/"$task_native_run"-end.utc
 sha256sum -c build/small-divisor-native/timing-captures/pre-capture.sha256 > build/small-divisor-native/timing-captures/source-check-after-"$task_native_run".log || exit 74
done
wc -c build/small-divisor-native/timing-captures/first-results.txt build/small-divisor-native/timing-captures/repeat-results.txt
cat build/small-divisor-native/timing-captures/first.status build/small-divisor-native/timing-captures/repeat.status
